localChanges: Aircraft sent on a GoTo now fly over your cities and Carriers on the way, and land only where the journey ends, or on a Carrier they reach with their last move (closes #82).
Holding on a city or Carrier next to one of your aircraft now offers Move as well as Land, so you can fly over it. The arrow keys still land.
Computer players now bring their aircraft back to their Carriers as well as their cities, and fly them again afterwards.
Units aboard a ship or Carrier now show as Aboard.
